properties.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing
properties.why: Where Perseverance touched down in February 2021; a proven safe landing area and a fixed reference point for planning routes.

properties.name: Jezero Crater (approximate center)
properties.why: A 45 km crater that once held a lake, so it is a place to look for evidence of past water.

properties.name: Waypoint 1
properties.why: Candidate stop inside Jezero Crater, a few kilometers east of the landing site. Rename once the feature is identified.

properties.name: Waypoint 2
properties.why: Candidate stop in the north-eastern part of Jezero Crater. Rename once the feature is identified.

properties.name: Waypoint 3
properties.why: Candidate stop in the north-eastern part of Jezero Crater. Rename once the feature is identified.
